name: Fairmont Monte Carlo
positioning: Fairmont hotel in the heart of Monte Carlo, near the Casino plaza, with sea-view and garden-view rooms and terraces overlooking the Fairmont Hairpin
best_for: Travelers who want a central Monte Carlo base near the Casino plaza
Families visiting from July 1 to August 31, when the Little Explorers Club runs
Guests staying for events such as the Formula 1 or the Monaco Yacht Show

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Monte Carlo, near the Casino plaza.
The hotel is home to Nobu, Nikki Beach and Amù.
Rooms offer sea views or quiet garden views.
The bathrooms in the Garden View rooms feature Le Labo bath amenities.
The hotel has two swimming pools.
The hotel has a fully equipped gym and fitness center.
The hotel suggests staying for events such as the Rolex Masters, the Formula 1, the Electric Grand Prix or the Monaco Yacht Show.
Check-in is from 3:00 pm and check-out is by 12:00 pm.

highlights.text: The Commodore Suite has three private furnished terraces overlooking the Mediterranean Sea and the Rock of Monaco.
Hairpin City View rooms have a private terrace overlooking the Fairmont Hairpin and the Monaco cityscape.
The Garden Suite has a private terrace overlooking the hotel's gardens and the Monte Carlo Casino.
The Little Explorers Club is a supervised children's club for ages 4 to 12, complimentary for hotel guests from July 1 to August 31.
The hotel is home to Nobu, Nikki Beach and Amù.

considerations.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
The Little Explorers Club runs only from July 1 to August 31.
WhataHotel notes the high-energy location may not suit those seeking tranquility.
